# Yoobi | Notebook with Printed Cover | Blush Multicolor | Pack of 3 (YOOB4192674)
Brand: Yoobi
Category: Notebooks & Writing Pads > Subject Notebooks

## Features
3 pack set of notebooks with 60 college ruled sheets in each notebook; Colors: blush grid, coral grid, blush; Paper size: 9.88" x 7.08"; Dimensions: 7.15" x .20" x 9.75"; Perfect for school, home or office

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 5.04 USD.
Rated 4.8 from 165 reviews.
Top review: Actually, I just opened my 3 pack a few minutes ago, because I also bought the light blueish green 3 pack from you guys too, I think they say"Work It" on the front of them...and now I'll most definitely be going to see if there are any other colors/varieties that I don't have yet, I hope so!! We use a lot of lists and other things, like emergency contact numbers..ect... You just can't beat a 3 pack of full size notebooks for $3! And bonus: they're freaking adorable!! So thanks guys!! Sorry, gotta get back to my "to do tonight" list! TTFN!I was hoping for more of a soft cover.Buy it it is really cheap and really niceI have good memory with the notebook. I used it for my pharmacy licensing exams and I passed.The quality of the paper is good. They are thick and can withhold writing using highlighters, pencils or dry ink pens.The color of the papers are bright which for the price is very good.The Zipper included is useful for small notebook or small cards if you use cards for studying.It is sturdy and it hold the papers even after six months of using.It includes 3 notebook which is amazing and very affordable.These are decent, compact notebooks. They are smaller than standard notebook paper, and slim—making them easy to fit into even a smaller bag or backpack. The lines start at the very top of the page, and go from side to side – no margins or vertical lines. They are also lined front and back. That is fantastic for general note keeping, doodles, journals, etc. If you’re a person who likes side margins and/or and that big space at the top, though, these will disappoint you.The top space is ever so slightly larger than the rest, but you could still easily use these as double-sided notebooks and start notes on one side for one subject and the other side for another. Just add a sticker or a title to the outside cover on the “back.”The biggest problem I have with these is the front covers —they crease a lot very easily. Even after only the first few uses, the front covers start looking shoddy because the creases form cracks and the covers won’t close completely flat.This is a three pack of Yoobi notebooks. They have three different designs yet all match nicely. Each notebook has 60 sheets of college ruled paper. The pages are a decent thickness. Not incredibly thick but not so thin everything you write with will bleed right through. The quality is definitely good. I don’t believe the pages tear out easily (if at all. They aren’t perforated.I’ve been using these since they arrived and I use felt tip pens on them without any bleeding through. I don’t have any complaints at all with them but I do think if you are a student using them you would just have to worry about the number of pages per notebook. For the price and how great these are to write in though, these are excellent notebooks. I definitely recommend them.I received these notebooks specifically to write a review. That said, I try to be honest and open in all my reviews.(Please see the enclosed picture.)These notebooks are a little less than paper-sized and perfect for tucking in a large bag or backpack. The covers are made from a sturdy paper with a slightly glossy finish.The inside cover is decorated with fun black and white designs with a friendly reminder that Yoobi will donate items to children in need when you purchase one of their products.The paper is lined on both sides, though the spine must be bent to lie the book flat.The notebooks are basic and functional. Good quality for what you get!
